create_mc_dropout_agent: create an mc dropout agent from a McDropoutConfig with configurable dropout rate, hidden sizes, and learning rate
run_droprate_sweep: run a sweep over dropout rates from 0.0 to 0.9 with dropout input toggled on and off
run_l2reg_sweep: run a sweep over l2 regularization with adaptive weight scale and length scales of 1, 3, and 10
run_network_sweep: run a sweep over network architectures with hidden sizes of (50,50), (100,100), and (50,50,50)
run_combined_sweep: run a combined sweep aggregating droprate, l2reg, and network sweeps into a single sequence of configurations
